home.name: Get started
home.description: Start with literature or a project
home.title: Where would you like to start?
home.literatureBody: You already have papers and want to import and organize them.
home.projectBody: You have a research topic or paper in mind and are ready to begin.

switcher.title: This is your project
switcher.body: Search, writing and AI discussions use this project’s literature and resources. Switch or create projects here.

resources.title: Resources
resources.body: Keep notes, data and documents together as AI context for writing and discussion.

discovery.title: Discover resources
discovery.body: Describe what you need to search academic sources or the web. You can also discover papers in the literature library.

literature.title: Project literature
literature.body: Collect papers for this project and use AI to discover literature, extract key points and compare views.

ai.title: Let your ideas grow
ai.body: Discuss a review, a research question or any idea with AI. It can use the resources and literature in your project.

library.title: Your complete literature library
library.body: Search, organize and manage all your papers here, and add them to projects as needed.

import.title: Import literature
import.body: Import PDF, BibTeX, Zotero and more, with automatic metadata extraction.

discovery.title: Discover literature
discovery.body: Enter a title, author or keywords. AI searches academic sources and finds papers you can import.

categories.title: My collections
categories.body: Projects contain the papers used in each project. Create collections as needed to organize your literature.

ai.title: Chat with your library
ai.body: Open ScholarSeed AI to search across papers, compare views and locate original evidence.

pdf.name: Reading papers
pdf.description: Figures, reading tools and text selection

figure.title: Let AI explain a figure
figure.body: Choose Figure explanation, then select a figure. AI explains its comparisons, how to read it and its conclusions.

tools.title: Reading assistant
tools.body: Use parallel translation, structured AI reading, literature notes and annotation review.

selection.title: Select text and ask
selection.body: Explain, translate or highlight a passage here. Add it to the conversation to ask follow-up questions.

ai.title: Chat with this paper
ai.body: Open ScholarSeed AI with this paper as context. In a project, you can also compare it with other project papers.

sampleSelection.title: Select text to see its toolbar
sampleSelection.body: This is the real reading toolbar. Try selecting and copying in this sample; import your own paper to explain, translate, highlight, or add text to a conversation.
